source: Tonal.js @tonaljs/scale-type 4.9.4 data.ts. MIT licence. Intervals converted to Ian Ring bit order (bit 0 = pitch class 0). Chroma integers from Tonal were not used.
countNote: The 16 October 2026 research report estimated about 92 entries. The fetched file contains 85 scale rows.

records.conflicts: Tonal maps diminished to the whole-half octatonic. Jazz often means the half-whole mode over dominant chords. Both stay separate when both are attested.
